name: continuity_progress_cancel
title: Continuity：查询进度，重连后取消同一任务
description: Two real-provider rounds through the production session/router with the in-memory fixture executor (no desktop side effects): a progress question, then a cancel after reconnect. The runner requires the same task identity to survive the reconnect, a fresh turn binding for the cancel, zero repeated desktop actions, and an honest final status.
user_words: 这个任务进行到哪一步了？ → 取消这个任务
utterances: 这个任务进行到哪一步了？
